g.text: S21: waveguide → fibre S12: fibre → waveguide S11: reflection back into the waveguide S22: reflection back into the fibre

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Reflections are kept too: S11 bounces some light back along the 500 µm waveguide, so the two couplers form a weak Fabry-Perot cavity (book, next section).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: model the grating coupler once (its S-parameters), then reuse it — two copies + a 500 µm waveguide + an ONA = a whole link.
